Flat FRONT ELEVATION, no perspective or side walls. Six flat neutral material values #11161d #191f28 #232a34 #2e3641 #3b434f #4c5460; no white highlights or coloured outlines. Flat full-width matching top/bottom stone bands, no roof, crown or finial, no protrusions beyond rectangular shaft. Mostly intact.
